notes: Community emissions are the CRV actually minted to gauge stakers on claim. CRV accrued in gauges but not yet claimed is not counted until it is minted, and no future emissions are projected.
CRV has no hard cap. The 3.03B figure is the asymptotic total of the inflation schedule plus the 1.3B initial supply.

Early Users.methodology: 5% of supply (151.5M CRV) vested over one year to liquidity providers who used Curve before the token launch.

early-users.name: Early Users
early-users.methodology: Read from the on-chain vesting escrow.

Employees.methodology: 3% of supply (90.9M CRV) vested over two years to employees.

employees.name: Employees
employees.methodology: Read from the on-chain vesting escrow, plus the amount unlocked at start.

Team & Investors.methodology: 30% of supply (909.1M CRV) vested over two to four years to shareholders (team and investors).

team-and-investors.name: Team & Investors
team-and-investors.methodology: Read from the three on-chain vesting escrows, plus the amounts unlocked at start.

Community.methodology: CRV inflation distributed to liquidity gauges according to veCRV votes. Tracks CRV actually minted by the Minter when LPs claim, following a schedule of 274.8M CRV in the first year reduced by 2^(1/4) each year.

gauge-emissions.name: Gauge Emissions
gauge-emissions.methodology: CRV minted by the Minter contract to gauge stakers, tracked via Transfer events from the zero address on the CRV token since the first mining epoch.
